row.body: The map routes past a checkpoint to the trial plots. A key tag says “sprayer pump.” In the margin, “wind turned at ten; east beans scorched by noon” is underlined twice.
row.title: The key marked for the last spray run

sidecar.gloss: A spray route and a crop-damage note share the same marked key.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could reroute through farm roads during a closure; wind damage might be ordinary field loss rather than a program failure.
